_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. model sheet of a stocky man in his mid-thirties in a faded brown canvas work jacket with the hood down, a gray hoodie beneath, backwards cap, jeans, tan boots; front, profile, and the key pose: walking away down a gravel drive with hands in pockets seen from behind; expression heads: tired kindness, thoughtful, easy; labeled GULLY 2014. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
